bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 61
printf 'GATEAPP_CHECKOUT_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'GATEAPP_CHECKOUT_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git -C "$root" branch --show-current)"
printf 'GATEAPP_DIRTY_FILES=%s\n' "$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain | wc -l)"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 63
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 64
printf 'LIVE_IMAGE_ID=%s\n' "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
docker logs --tail 240 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 65
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='link_button_posts' AND column_name='media_extras';")" = 1 || exit 66
echo 'GAYBBS_RUNTIME=READY'
echo 'USERBOT_SESSION_OWNER=ACTIVE'
echo 'LINK_SCHEMA=PASS'
